fields.title: Bounded, proportional and measured autonomous acceptance
fields.body: Complements existing KISS, truthfulness and efficiency Aspects with the new roadmap's execution/acceptance obligations. Applies to downstream slices, not a new enforcement subsystem.
acceptanceCriteria: Scale investigation, retrieval and verification to demonstrated impact; mandatory governance remains mandatory and evidence reuse requires current validity.
At acceptance record baseline and outcome for at least one of capability, correctness, architectural simplicity or operational efficiency; demonstrate no unjustified regression in the others.
Repeated failure without new evidence stops execution, preserves recoverable state/evidence and reports the exact blocker; no threshold escalation or repetitive repository scans.
Inspect actual touched methods, callers, public contracts, ownership and failure paths; consequential defects, silent failures and invalid verification block release despite green tests.

Use existing leases, preview fingerprints, guarded mutations, tests, independent acceptance, receipts and projection sync under the user workflow; minimize manual bookkeeping without weakening guarantees.

fields.title: Maintainability / KISS
acceptanceCriteria: Entity-owned behavior and thin adapters; no service wrappers, shadow graph or generic workflow infrastructure.
Method-level review finds the smallest implementation that meets acceptance.

fields.title: Robustness / truthfulness
acceptanceCriteria: Exact facts use language tooling; heuristic facts and excerpts are labelled.
Completion requires verified acceptance; missing capability or evidence returns a truthful blocker.

fields.title: GovernedChangeScope ownership and Semantika consumer boundary
fields.body: Accepted requirements, not approval of unreviewed implementation details: one authoritative immutable scope joins declared targets, attributable observed guarded effects, applicable Rule layer identities/versions and relevant evidence. Ticket.resolve coordinates; existing change engine owns effects/attribution; RuleStore owns effective governance; existing verifier owns independent acceptance; Semantika owns consistency/atomicity. Verification and receipt issuance consume the same snapshot; scope, applicable governance and relevant evidence changes invalidate it. Distinguish execution-owned changes from unrelated pre-existing dirty state; preserve child boundaries and distinct Rule layers. Fail closed on unknown authoritative scope. Reuse Git, graph and guarded changes; no parallel tracker, duplicated scope calculations or compatibility scaffolding. Existing Gate 5 TKT-DOCTRINE-G5-RELEASE remains Blocked; fields/evidence untouched. Reuse its architecture audit, rather than create a competing implementation ticket. Outstanding Semantika question: public consistent multi-collection governance selection/read set including newly applicable Rules/ownership relationships, tied to atomic conditional receipt+completion. Public atomic batch CAS does not by itself establish that selection guarantee; StorageSession contract is ambiguous. Read public API/README/contract tests first. Record ambiguity as documentation/API issue; inspect internals only for a concrete defect with a stated reason. No Semantika refactoring or AIWF persistence compensation is authorized. Proposed detailed scope design still requires review.

fields.title: Roadmap execution and acceptance policy
fields.body: Implement only graph-ready, small independently verifiable slices. Required order: narrow Semantika public transaction contract -> existing Gate 5 governed scope and independent acceptance/Doctrine closure -> specific Transaction Integrity and Consumer Contract slices -> necessary Workflow Efficiency foundation -> existing CodeMutator plus explicit go/no-go -> Continuous Product Verification -> evidence-backed Engineering Intelligence. Configuration/interface work overlaps only when its actual prerequisites are verified. Never depend on an entire epic where a specific capability suffices. No independent planner, shadow transaction manager, second test database, scheduler or generic coding-agent subsystem. Routine workflow: Investigate -> Plan (existing preparation) -> Execute -> Verify -> Done. Historical R3 and its R2/R1 dependencies remain real obligations. CodeMutator is not delayed by optional improvements. Consequential structural defects at dogfood stop CPV; minor nonblocking improvements enter backlog.

fields.title: AI-Workflow (AIWF)
fields.purpose:
AIWF aims to dramatically improve the **quality, speed and cost-efficiency of AI-assisted software engineering**.

It enables developers and AI coding agents to produce and maintain tight, production-quality software by combining semantically connected project knowledge, engineering intelligence, integrated work management, efficient execution and worthwhile verification.

**Performance ambition:** Achieve 20–90% reduction in LLM token consumption and 40–90% reduction in elapsed engineering time on comparable tasks, without compromising correctness or maintainability, but rather increasing them.

These are measurable product targets, not guaranteed outcomes. The ultimate measure of success is correctly engineered software, achieved with substantially less effort, time and avoidable technical debt.
actors: Developer / Product Owner: Defines intended product behavior, reviews proposals, makes decisions and authorizes consequential changes.
AI Coding Agent: Uses AIWF to understand, investigate, plan, implement, test and verify engineering work within its delegated authority.
Maintainer: Understands and evolves existing software, investigates defects, manages technical work and protects its integrity.
Verifier: Independently assesses actual engineering outcomes against applicable requirements and evidence. May be human or AI.
fields.scope:
AIWF provides an integrated engineering environment encompassing:

**Product understanding**

- A canonical Product Charter and semantically connected Goals, Features, Aspects, User/Actor Stories and related knowledge.
- AI-assisted discovery, generation, reconciliation and controlled evolution of product definitions.
- Identification of conflicts, dependencies, inconsistencies and product drift.

**Engineering intelligence**

- A persistent semantic project graph connecting product intent, work, code, architecture, tests, decisions and evidence.
- Efficient, targeted retrieval, dependency and impact analysis, code intelligence and refactoring support.
- Intelligent selection and combination of deterministic operations, System-1 and LLM reasoning to optimize engineering economics.

**Work management and execution**

- Integrated Epics, Tickets, Bugs, priorities, dependencies, planning views and work lifecycle.
- Grounded investigation, planning, implementation, testing, correction and completion.
- Discovery, reuse, import and justified generation of capabilities and skills, combining knowledge and executable functionality where appropriate.

**Quality and verification**

- Dharmax-way as the governing engineering method, including US-driven test-first development and the Prime Directive.
- Correct, maintainable implementations with minimal justified complexity.
- Meaningful testing, independent current verification, truthful progress and durable evidence.

**Accessibility and continuity**

- Integration with external AI coding agents through MCP, skills and supported plugin interfaces.
- Direct operation through CLI, interactive shell and graphical interfaces.
- Persistent project context enabling work to continue across sessions, developers and agents.

AIWF supports new functionality, modification of existing behavior, Bug resolution, refactoring and justified technical maintenance.
nonGoals: Replace the developer's authority over product intent or consequential decisions.
Become a general-purpose chatbot or content-generation application.
Merely generate code, documentation, Tickets or other artifacts without advancing an actual engineering objective.
Replace established development tools or suitable ecosystem capabilities unnecessarily.
Impose rigid methodologies, unnecessary planning ceremonies or artificial product/work hierarchies.
Optimize token consumption or speed at the expense of correctness, maintainability or safety.
Treat passing internal tests, generated code, completed Ticket states or AI assertions as sufficient proof of product correctness.
fields.bounds:
1. **Developer authority:** Product intent and material changes require appropriate review and approval. Every downstream product definition is examined against the charter; material conflicts or drift must be exposed and explicitly answered.

2. **Engineering quality:** Dharmax-way and its Prime Directive govern the work. The simplest correct solution wins. Avoid assumptions, unnecessary abstraction, duplicated ownership and accumulating avoidable technical debt.

3. **Grounded intelligence:** Investigation and engineering decisions must use relevant, attributable project knowledge and actual evidence. Unknown or uncertain information must not be represented as established fact.

4. **Efficiency:** Prefer inexpensive deterministic mechanisms where sufficient. Use AI reasoning when it adds value, with relevant context, appropriate capabilities and measurable resource consumption.

5. **Safety and integrity:** Respect authorization, project boundaries, existing work and guarded mutation contracts. Changes must not silently damage or overwrite unrelated work.

6. **Truthful verification:** Product acceptance requires relevant observed behavior and valid current evidence. Verification effort should be proportional to the actual obligations and risks, not performed merely for appearances.

7. **Durability and consistency:** Maintain connected, reusable project state without competing sources of truth. Preserve the distinction between intended product behavior, engineering progress and demonstrated implementation.

8. **Extensibility and simplicity:** Support varied projects, coding agents and development environments through reusable capabilities and justified integrations, without introducing unnecessary parallel infrastructure.

A person or agent may fulfill more than one role, subject to applicable authorization and verification-independence requirements.

fields.title: Release actor can inspect evidence and gaps for a product claim

Release output distinguishes unsupported claims, current observations and inferences; green tests alone do not certify readiness.

acceptanceCriteria: Literal last ticket is never treated as an entity ID.
Most-recently-created and most-recently-referenced semantics are defined; ambiguous/no-context cases fail explicitly.
Explicit-ID editing, CLI/plain-shell/TTY behavior and unrelated records remain unchanged.

fields.title: Maintainer receives useful evidence-backed engineering recommendations

acceptanceCriteria: A real use case is justified by CPV evidence before implementation.
Accuracy/false-positive costs and effort improvement are measured.
No autonomous repair/housekeeping is implied by a recommendation.

acceptanceCriteria: A real failing Bun execution links to affected enduring Stories and capability/requirements.
Failure clusters can relate to multiple Bugs or no confirmed Bug; proposals are not promoted to facts.
Recovery preserves verification history and does not automatically close related Bugs.

acceptanceCriteria: Caller obtains a grounded read-only Ticket dossier with mandatory acceptance, Aspect and exact code evidence or precise missing-input requirements.
System-1 unavailable still yields correct behavior by retaining all mandatory evidence and falling back safely without failing engineering work.

fields.story: Caller can make a broad Ticket executable or receive precise missing-input requirements
acceptanceCriteria: Caller makes a broad Ticket executable through reviewed ordinary Ticket children or receives precise missing-input requirements; rerun creates no duplicates.

fields.story: Caller can process Story/Feature/Epic into the next useful work/intent layer without ceremonial artifacts
acceptanceCriteria: Caller processes Story/Feature/Epic into necessary reviewed next-layer intent/work, reusing stable artifacts without ceremonial Stories or duplicate Tickets.

fields.title: Producer can ground dependency calls through public contracts

acceptanceCriteria: Required operations and imports are real and scope-grounded; ambiguous contracts produce an exact blocker.
Examples and measurements show fewer first-attempt failures and repeated retrieval without weakening governance.

fields.title: Reporter can register and retain a reproducible Bug
fields.story: When observed behavior differs from an accepted requirement, I can register/reuse a typed Bug with reproducible evidence and governed lifecycle, without losing its identity in generic feature work.
acceptanceCriteria: Bug identity and lane semantics are explicit, not inferred from fix/bug substrings.
Duplicate reports and multiple failed tests reconcile without assuming one-to-one mapping.
Resolution/reopening cites current evidence and does not follow one passing test automatically.

fields.story: Caller can delegate a Ticket and receive verified completion / needs-input / blocked
acceptanceCriteria: Caller delegates a Ticket and receives explicitly verified completion, needs_input or blocked, with safe edits, bounded repair and truthful leases.

fields.title: Developer can ask compound goals and receive grounded, truthful answers across all requested parts
fields.story: Developer can ask compound goals and receive grounded, truthful answers across all requested parts
acceptanceCriteria: Compound multi-part goals (e.g. project goal + critical path + missing work) acquire governing evidence, do not exhaust steps echoing notes, and answer every requested part.

Recommendation and candidate ranking queries (e.g. 2nd recommended ticket, extremes comparison) evaluate eligibility constraints against governing policy without hallucinating or selecting ineligible items.

Semantic capability discovery on compound queries correctly normalizes domain/object aliases (e.g. "project", "critical path") to valid registered capabilities without unsupported classification errors.

fields.title: Developer obtains reliable independent verification within approved spending
fields.intent: Obtain trustworthy independent verification without repeatedly selecting a model that has failed its contract or spending without approval.
fields.initialState: A Ticket has actual test evidence. Available model advice, explicit developer routes and observed verification qualification/failure evidence may exist. Paid execution is unapproved by default.
fields.action: Request canonical Ticket verification; where paid execution is desired, configure approved providers and tasks and an explicit cumulative spending ceiling for that verification operation.
fields.expectedResult: AIWF uses existing Radar advice and llm-utils routing to select an available verification model, with explicit developer routes and spending restrictions taking precedence. It records observed contract qualification/failure separately from advice and avoids automatically selecting a model whose latest observed verification contract failed. The reviewer receives exact valid evidence identifiers and applicable Rule identities. A malformed or incomplete response receives at most one targeted correction containing actual validation errors. Missing mandatory assessments, invalid citations and inconclusive mandatory Rules still block acceptance. Paid execution requires developer approval of provider/task and a spending ceiling; AIWF enforces that ceiling across all scopes/retries of the operation and reports actual usage. Only complete independent acceptance creates a canonical receipt and Done/verified state. No eligible authorized model or exhausted budget yields a truthful blocker, without a receipt. Explicitly configured failed models are not silently overridden; their contract failures remain blocking. Existing Radar, routing, verifier, configuration and Semantika owners only. No new routing engine, duplicate Radar, generic retry or governance subsystem. Preserve historical proof. BASIC Product Intent #2 stays closed; #3 and Consult excluded.
